name: Piano
summary: Piano is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trading signals from multiple indicator confluences, similar to how piano keys combine to form chords. It enters trades when multiple technical indicators align in the same direction and manages positions with predefined stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: Piano是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过多个指标共振产生交易信号，类似于钢琴按键组合形成和弦。当多个技术指标同向对齐时入场交易，并使用预定义的止损止盈管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: Piano EA采用多指标共振的策略概念，当多个动量类指标同时发出同方向信号时触发入场条件。入场条件通常基于RSI、MACD或随机指标的超买超卖区域配合趋势方向确认。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及可能的移动止损机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额比例的模式，但具体参数取决于用户设置。资金管理方面，该EA可能缺乏动态仓位调整和最大回撤控制机制，在连续亏损时风险敞口较大。整体策略依赖指标共振的准确性，在震荡行情中可能产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: Piano EA employs a multi-indicator confluence strategy concept, triggering entry conditions when multiple momentum indicators simultaneously emit signals in the same direction. Entry conditions are typically based on overbought/oversold zones from RSI, MACD, or Stochastic indicators combined with trend direction confirmation. Exit conditions include fixed take profit and stop loss levels along with a possible trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or an account balance proportional model, though specific parameters depend on user settings. In terms of money management, the EA likely lacks dynamic position adjustment and maximum drawdown control mechanisms, leaving risk exposure elevated during consecutive losing streaks. The overall strategy relies on the accuracy of indicator confluence, which may generate frequent false signals during ranging market conditions.
pros: 多指标共振减少虚假信号，提高入场质量
固定止损止盈提供明确的风险控制边界
参数可配置性强，适应不同交易品种和周期
独立魔术编号避免与其他EA订单冲突
pros_en: Multi-indicator confluence reduces false signals and improves entry quality
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide clear risk control boundaries
Highly configurable parameters adapt to different instruments and timeframes
Independent magic number prevents order conflicts with other EAs
cons: 多指标共振在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态仓位调整机制，无法根据市场波动率自适应调整手数
没有最大回撤控制和日内亏损限额，资金管理不够完善
固定止盈止损未考虑ATR等波动率指标，在不同市场条件下可能不合理
cons_en: Multi-indicator confluence tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing mechanism unable to adapt lot size based on market volatility
No maximum drawdown control or daily loss limit makes money management insufficient
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for ATR-based volatility, potentially unreasonable across varying market conditions
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自适应调整
添加最大回撤控制和日内亏损限额，增强资金管理安全性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit mechanism to adapt to market volatility
Implement maximum drawdown control and daily loss limits to enhance money management safety

risk_points: 缺乏最大回撤保护机制，极端行情下可能遭受重大损失
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时可能过宽而高波动时过窄
risk_points_en: Lacks maximum drawdown protection mechanism, may suffer significant losses during extreme market conditions
Fixed stop loss does not account for market volatility changes, potentially too wide during low volatility and too narrow during high volatility
